summary: The claim rests on published Xenopus eye-induction experiments; no deposited images, voltage maps or per-animal tables were found in Dryad, Zenodo, GEO, BioStudies or DataCite. The Pax6 comparison comes from separate studies, so no single dataset covers both manipulations.
